description:
Use this when the user wants an everyday change to a clip they already have: "make the captions bigger and
        yellow", "cut the silences", "remove the ums", "add chill music", "put a title on it", "split my facecam",
        "trim the start". clip_id: from list_clips or a finished job. Set only what was asked: caption_size small / medium / large / x-large (or 10-100);
        caption_color, highlight_color (name or hex); caption_position auto / top / middle / bottom; caption_animation
        (bounce, pop, fade, none...); uppercase; remove_silences (pauses of min_pause_seconds or more, default 0.6);
        remove_filler_words; music (featured, phonk, hiphop, vlog, funny, chill, epic, upbeat, electronic, calm,
        acoustic, gaming, sad, or off) with music_volume quiet / normal / loud; hook_title (text at the top, or off);
        layout standard or facecam_split; auto_zoom; emojis; trim_start_seconds, trim_end_seconds.
        Not for: caption fonts or templates, filters, effects, transitions, speed or shape (style_clip), text, sticker
        or sound-effect overlays (add_to_clip), subtitles in another language (translate_captions), or cutting new clips
        from a long video (find_clips). The previous version stays in the editor's undo history; the clip's video is
        replaced by the new render. Costs no Horizon Units. Returns job_id; poll job_status, then preview_frame or
        get_download_link. Options the account can't use are refused by name before anything changes.
name: edit_clip
title: Edit a clip
